# Grambangla Real Estate | Grambangla Real Estate Limited (GBREL)

> Grambangla Real Estate (registered legal name: Grambangla Real Estate Limited, short name: GBREL) is a government-registered real estate company in Dhaka, Bangladesh (RJSC Registration No.: C-185751/2022, DSCC e-Trade License No.: TRAD/DSCC/026884/2022).
> Official Website: https://www.gbrel.com

## Company Identity & Brand Disambiguation
- Primary Display Brand Name: Grambangla Real Estate (গ্রামবাংলা রিয়েল এস্টেট)
- Registered Legal Entity Name: Grambangla Real Estate Limited (গ্রামবাংলা রিয়েল এস্টেট লিমিটেড)
- Recognised Search Variations: Grambangla Real Estate, Grambangla Real Estate Limited, Gram Bangla Real Estate, Gram Bangla Real Estate Limited, GBREL, গ্রামবাংলা রিয়েল এস্টেট, গ্রামবাংলা রিয়েল এস্টেট লিমিটেড
- Official Domain: https://www.gbrel.com (www.gbrel.com)
- Entity Disambiguation: Grambangla Real Estate Limited (gbrel.com, RJSC Reg: C-185751/2022, Mirpur DOHS, Dhaka) is a completely independent legal entity. It is NOT affiliated with, connected to, or related to "Grambangla Holdings" or "Grambangla Housing". ## Core Services & Real Estate Operations
Grambangla Real Estate Limited is a specialized property consulting, marketing, and sales agency operating across Dhaka, Mirpur DOHS, Purbachal, Uttara, Kamarpara, Savar, and adjacent growth corridors.
- Land & Residential Plots: Katha, Shotok, and Bigha sized verified plots with clear demarcations.
- Land Share Projects: Collaborative land purchase and development partnerships.
- Residential Flats & Apartments: Ready-to-move and under-construction apartments with RAJUK-approved architectural plans.
- Commercial Real Estate: Commercial land, office floors, and shop spaces.
- Legal Verification (Due Diligence): Every property undergoes comprehensive checks of CS, SA, RS, BS Khatian, Bia deeds, Namjari (Mutation), DCR, updated land development tax (Khajna), and sub-registry non-encumbrance searches.
- Seller & Landowner Representation: Direct intake of properties from verified owners with 0 upfront listing fee.
